mainEntity.name: How does Google Business Profile optimization compare to traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Business Profile optimization focuses specifically on improving visibility within Google Maps and local search results, primarily for businesses with physical locations or those serving a specific geographic area. It emphasizes factors like proximity, relevance to local queries, and prominence (reviews, completeness of profile). Traditional SEO, conversely, aims to improve a website's ranking in organic search results for a broader range of keywords, often without a direct geographical constraint. While distinct, they are complementary; a strong GBP can drive traffic to a website optimized through traditional SEO, creating a holistic digital presence.
acceptedAnswer.description: GBP optimization focuses on local search and Maps visibility for physical businesses, while traditional SEO targets broader organic search rankings. They are complementary.
